title: S4-NEW-03 — The last frame stays.
goal: A single-frame project cannot delete its only frame; duplicating it and deleting the duplicate returns to exactly one frame with Bun's artwork exact, and Delete is unavailable again.

steps.why: The only frame cannot be deleted.
The duplicate shows the same artwork.
Exactly one frame remains, with the original artwork.
With one frame left, Delete is unavailable again.
